blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.why: **ча́стный** — private. Source: Wiktionary, «-ный» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ный#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.
**частный** — ча́стный: private; particular; individual. Wiktionary: часть + -ный.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

**верен** — ве́рный: true, faithful, loyal; true, right, correct. Wiktionary: ве́ра + -ный.
